contentText:
You probably know John Roberts best as the voice of Linda Belcher on Bob's Burgers . The show just wrapped up its 16th season and shows no signs of slowing down anytime soon. The show remains a reliable source of laughs, top-notch puns, and frankly wholesome fun.

Comedy is just part of Roberts' life, however. In addition to his appearances on Gravity Falls and Comedy Bang! Bang! , he's also a musician with deep roots in New York City's queer nightlife scene. He just released his latest record, I Am , on Friday, and it dabbles in '80s pop, '90s house, and even dashes of '00s rave. But while the record sounds made for the dance floor, it actuall …
